seo_title: Experiences | Walks, game drives and the Maasai village | Mara River Camp
seo_description: Walk with Maasai guides at first light, follow the herds on a game drive, visit the Maasai village, take a sundowner on the plains and end the day by the fire. Every experience at Mara River Camp, by family.
label: Experiences
title: Days shaped by the river and the people who know it
lead: Every experience is led by someone from the camp and earns a stamp in your Exploreans Passport. Browse them by family.
